description: This file declares exported API functions for the HTTP Webs Trans Object within a broader web server framework, providing function prototypes for creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization of web transaction objects.

methods.name: HttpCreateWebsTrans
methods.description: Creates a new HTTP Webs Transaction object with provided context handles.

methods.name: HttpWstoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Webs Trans object with specified contexts.

methods.name: HttpWstoRemove
methods.description: Removes and deallocates the Webs Trans object.

methods.name: HttpWstoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary subordinate objects into the Webs Trans object.

methods.name: HttpWstoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Webs Trans object to a ready state.
